summary.text: Trent Maier is a Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 4-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

An electrical engineer, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he co-founded Trailbreaker Cider with his family and serves on the boards of the Greater Spokane Valley Chamber of Commerce and Greater Spokane Incorporated.

paragraphs.text: Trent Maier graduated from Fulton High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 2003.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he earned his degree in electrical engineering and worked in the automation and energy industries before becoming an entrepreneur.

Maier said he and his family founded Trailbreaker Cider and grew it into a cider manufacturer in the Spokane Valley, and that he led construction of its manufacturing facility, restaurant and event center.
He said he serves on the boards of the Greater Spokane Valley Chamber of Commerce and Greater Spokane Incorporated.
His first listed campaign priority was lower taxes and affordability.
